notes: Read-only run. Payout module: decided Sep 25/Sep 30 requirements exist only as design cards (WAGR-465/466/467); no Payouts epic and no build stories although Sep 25 put referrer payout batching in this release. Earlier decisions superseded (not reported): Jul 15 manual bonus entry (now matrix, WAGR-289), Aug 27 separate payout currency deferral (now two currencies per signup, WAGR-465), Sep 1 BA commission fields/placeholders (Sep 25 moved commissions outside Salesforce; WAGR-467). Most Aug 18 referrer record decisions are covered (WAGR-192/193/190/189/191/73/74/177/178/75). WAGR-69/367 (operator bonus), WAGR-211/216/461 (commercial terms) and WAGR-477 (import templates) are in the shortlist but belong to other areas. L1990 (referrer data not synced to CMS) needs no build and was not reported. Sep 25 actions L3131 (guided payout workflow design) and Sep 23-28 referrer creation items are covered by WAGR-465, WAGR-418, WAGR-427, WAGR-428.
